route: Permit for Foreign Labour to Work in Lao

permit.applies: The legal entity (labour unit) using the foreign worker applies at the Ministry of Labour and Social Welfare's offices (Skill Development and Employment Department), naming each worker, position and engagement period.
permit.first: An approved foreign-labour import quota; the worker cross-checked against the Immigration Department's blacklist and a working visa from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
permit.eligibility: "having technical capacity and competence that meet with the requirement of the specific position; (ii) being more than 20 years old; (iii) having the ability to transfer the technical knowledge to the Lao labour"
permit.feesNote: The MoLSW datasheet (Notice No. 0295/MOLSW of 15 February 2012) prints a service fee of 50000.00 and an application fee of 10000.00, total 60000.00, with no currency; the same datasheet states its penalties in USD and the portal’s visa datasheet its fees in LAK, so the currency isn’t inferred.

sources.title: Lao Trade Portal, Datasheet MoLSW-SDED-7: Permit for Foreign Labour to Work in Lao (last modified 09.01.2018)
sources.said: Any legal entity that intends to utilise those foreign labour that they have imported according to the approved quota. … Time it takes to the 14 … (i) having technical capacity and competence that meet with the requirement of the specific position; (ii) being more than 20 years old; (iii) having the ability to transfer the technical knowledge to the Lao labour; … 3. The foreign labour shall receive working visa from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs … YES 12 … Foreign labour can only work in Lao PDF for the consecutive period of the maximum of 4 years and they shall return to their residence. … YES 50000.00 0.00 10000.00 60000.00 … No. 0295/MOLSW, dated 15 February 2012

blockers.sought: The currency of the work permit’s fees (Notice No. 0295/MOLSW of 15 February 2012)
